description: This file defines interfaces for process container management within the WPEFramework. It includes abstractions for container metadata, network interfaces, memory and CPU info, and container lifecycle management.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Iterator interface for network interfaces within a container, providing methods for retrieving interface name, address count, and specific addresses.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface for retrieving memory usage statistics of a container, including allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface for retrieving CPU usage statistics of a container, including total usage, per-core usage, and number of cores.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Represents a container entity, providing methods for obtaining container ID, PID, memory and processor info, network interfaces, running state, and control functions for starting and stopping.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Iterator interface to enumerate containers, primarily providing access to container IDs.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates a new container instance with specified ID, search paths, log path, and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework, specifying log path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all created containers.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific container by its ID, or null if not found.

ctags.name: IContainerIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class IContainerIterator : public Core::IIterator, public Core::IReferenceCounted {$/

ctags.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class INetworkInterfaceIterator : public Core::IIterator,  public Core::IReferenceCounted  {$/
